category_title: First-grade students who struggle with independent literacy tasks and prefer social or auditory reading
scenario_title: Independent writing of text connections at workstations
minimal_context: The student is at a workstation during independent work time, tasked with writing a text-to-text connection to their book in their journal.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your workstation and write a connection to your book in your journal.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the blank journal page) I don't know how to write it by myself.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just think about what the book reminds you of and write it down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts the pencil down and looks around the room) Can I just tell my partner about the book instead?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, this is independent work time. You need to write your connection.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the journal away, completely off-task, and starts playing with a shoelace instead of attempting to share the text-to-text connection.) I can't write it.

task.content: write a connection to their book

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: instructed to write a connection to their book

behavior_patterns.condition: working on their spelling words or writing in journals
